_doc: Writing rules for tests/unit/copy.test.mjs, applied to every UI string (src/content/locales), the legal texts, the licence notes and the Markdown docs. Patterns are JavaScript regex sources, case-insensitive unless caseSensitive is true; lang limits a rule to one locale (Markdown counts as en). Why: plain language for beginners, and no stock phrases that make the text read as machine-written (Wikipedia: Signs of AI writing). See CONTRIBUTING.md, Writing.

rules.note: Use a comma, period, colon or parentheses.
No emojis. The answer marks are the plain characters U+2713 and U+2717.

rules.pattern: \b(pivotal|testament to|underscores|highlights the importance|broader landscape|evolving landscape|indelible|setting the stage)\b
(I hope this helps|Certainly!|Of course!|Great question|I'd be happy to|Feel free to|Don't hesitate to|rest assured)

rules.note: The staff has lines and spaces. Use 'space'.
